title: RenameResponse
description: Response emitted by `sqlite-graphrag rename` on stdout as a single JSON line.

truncated.description: GAP-SG-142: raised by the agent-native surface whenever it removed data from this envelope.

count.description: GAP-SG-142: emitted under --count-only, which replaces the payload. See agent-surface.schema.json#/$defs/CountOnlyEnvelope.

ghost_purged.description: True when a soft-deleted memory occupying the target name was permanently removed before rename. Present only when ghost purge occurred.
